title: Your workspace
lead: Pick a workspace, open a tool, or set up what your team can use. Everything stays optional—start with one tool.
empty: No workspaces yet. Create one below, or ask an admin to invite you.
emptyBody: Create a workspace to enable tools, or ask an admin to invite you.
whereYouArePurpose: This workspace controls which tools you can open and who can manage them.
workspaceHelp: Switch workspaces if you belong to more than one.
toolsPurpose: Open an enabled tool. Each product opens in its own app with the same sign-in.
manageToolsPurpose: Turn tools on so members can open them from this hub.
manageToolsLearnMore: Enabling a tool only unlocks access in this workspace. It does not require chat integrations. Members will see Open once a tool is on.
noTools: No tools enabled yet. Admins can enable tools below.
noToolsAdminBody: Enable at least one tool below so you and your members can open it from here.
noToolsMemberBody: Ask a workspace admin to enable a tool for this workspace.
planHint: Preview plan {{plan}}: up to {{teams}} teams, {{members}} members per team (preview only — Nest still enforces the workspace planKey).
createPurpose: A workspace holds your tools, teams, and members. You can add more later.
createNameHelp: Shown to members. Example: Acme Product
createSlugHelp: Lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens. Example: acme-product

vibestandup.body: Async daily standups for your team.

vibepoll.body: Quick polls and votes in the workspace.
